title: OCSEvent
description: Prototype schema for OCS events. All CONFIRM/OPEN QUESTION notes have been resolved into documented assumptions for Sprint 1.

event_id.description: Unique, idempotent ID for this event. Required so re-delivery/at-least-once streaming doesn't double-count a charge.

customer_id.description: Stable internal customer identifier. NOT the account number shown to the customer — resolve that via the CRM record if needed downstream.

account_id.description: Billing account identifier. Assumption: 1:1 mapping with customer_id for Sprint 1. Multi-line households deferred.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp with seconds precision. Assumption: OCS feed provides full precision, not truncated.

event_type.description: Charge category. Enum frozen for Sprint 1 mock data; reconciliation with real OCS categories deferred.

amount.description: Charge amount in major currency units (e.g. GBP pounds, USD dollars). Assumption: always major units, ingestion will normalize if real OCS emits minor units.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Assumption: multi-currency supported; no silent defaults.

description.description: Human-readable charge description. Assumption: stable wording per charge type in Sprint 1 mock data.

service_id.description: Optional identifier for specific line/service. Assumption: not required for Sprint 1, deferred until multi-service attribution is needed.
